description: The standard page hero: media with a teal copy slab. Used by About and any other page that needs one.

heading.default: From the boardroom to the classroom, every educator has a cape that they wear.

subheading.default: Every student deserves the opportunity to learn, grow, and succeed. We believe the best way to make that possible is by supporting the superheroes who make it happen every day.
